text:
omar_sales: Quick Acme POC update. Ran mixed workload they requested. Baseline 150 qps, 15s microbursts to 380 qps. Results: p95=230ms, p99=1.4s, max=3.2s, errors ~0.9% (long-gen timeouts). Need pricing delta for a tiny reserved burst pool and the completed security questionnaire (they require BYOK/KMS notes).

neha_se: can you paste the exact run command and the mix? did we enable embedding batching or KV cache?

omar_sales: run command (via stressbot):

```
stressbot start --target https://api.redwood.ai/v1/generate \
  --duration 600 --concurrency 150 --profile "microburst:380:15s@240s" \
  --mix "chat:65,embed:25,longgen:10" --model redwood/gptx-7b:v2-quant --region us-west-2
```

KV cache: enabled for chat. Embedding batching was OFF for this run.

raul_ops: looked at infra logs. Autoscaler observed spike and started provisioning at t+38s; GPUs were attached at t+120s due to cold allocation. That explains the tail. Recommend prewarm_nodes=2 or bump burst_window to 180s. Also enable embedding batching to reduce CPU queuing.

neha_se: mitigation checklist for next run: 1) embedding_batch_ms=30, 2) adaptive_batching=true, 3) burst_window_secs=180, 4) set request_timeout_secs=12 for longgen. Snippet: {"adaptive_batching":"true","embedding_batch_ms":"30","burst_window_secs":"180","request_timeout_secs":"12"}.

violet_prod: customer asks guaranteed p95 < 300ms for mixed profile and p99 < 1s for short chat. Security asks: BYOK CMK with HSM, SSO/SAML note, and a KMS flow diagram. I'll prepare the questionnaire answers tomorrow.

omar_sales: action items: neha -> updated runbook + PR with config; raul -> post autoscale timeline and whether prewarm would avoid cold attach; sales -> draft pricing delta (hosted per-token vs small reserved pool 2-node). Aim to share numbers by EOD. stressbot: upload markers?

stressbot: marker: run_id=acme-2026-04-10-rc1 summary_uploaded link=https://internal.storage/acme-acct/2026-04-10.json

omar_sales: thanks team, will consolidate and update Acme after we have infra confirmation and pricing delta.
